benchmark.typical: 3.9% average · 3.0–4.0% for education (highest of any industry)
benchmark.reference: Published 2026 industry benchmarks (Hootsuite, Socialinsider, Quid/Rival IQ, SociaVault) — a reference range, not your data.
benchmark.note: Document/carousel posts lead at ≈7% engagement. Dwell time and comments in the first hour decide distribution; a bare external link suppresses reach, so put links in the first comment.

actions.title: Fix distribution before creative
actions.detail: Text-with-image and document/carousel posts get the most dwell time. Post from a personal profile, tag the institution, and put any external link in the first comment. With 0 impressions recorded, the algorithm has no signal to work from — early interaction from real people (a department group, a faculty share, a comment within the first hour) is what starts it.

actions.title: Write for the decision-maker search, not the feed
actions.detail: Name the institution type and the outcome in the first line ("For colleges running manual attendance…"). Committees share content that names their problem; students do not amplify it for you.

diagnosis.mechanics: Text-with-image and document/carousel posts get the most dwell time. Post from a personal profile, tag the institution, and put any external link in the first comment.

benchmark.note: Pins are indexed like search results, not like a feed. A fresh pin usually takes 2–4 weeks before impressions appear, and it can keep driving traffic for months. Keywords in the pin title and board name do the targeting.

actions.title: Wait out the reporting lag
actions.detail: This platform reports metrics 24–48 h after publication. Nothing is broken; the numbers appear on their own.

actions.title: Publish the next item now
actions.detail: Consistency is what compounds on this platform — the lag makes a weekly cadence look empty for the first two days.

diagnosis.mechanics: Keyword-rich pin titles, vertical 2:3 creative, and boards named for what an institution would search ("college attendance tracking", "campus management"). Volume and consistency beat virality.
